summary: PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering from the University of Oklahoma (2025), with university teaching experience in Computer Programming, Communication Systems, and Wireless Communication. Research addresses reliable AI/ML for wireless networks, sensing and networked systems, including data-efficient propagation modeling, transfer learning, generative augmentation, outage detection and self-healing. Additional projects in wearable sensing and time-series analysis; engineering R&D experience at AT&T Labs, Futurewei and AT&T. Experience supporting engineering laboratories, mentoring student projects and translating technical research into reproducible experiments.
